proposals.evidence: DEDR 3630 compares Tamil naṉai (past naṉaint-), Malayalam nanayuka and Gondi nānd-/nān- become wet. The selected participial survey responses retain this intransitive wetting stem; causatives and compounds remain separate. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.

The selected adjective and neuter forms fit these attested senses; negative phrases meaning not good and unrelated loan adjectives are excluded. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.

proposals.evidence: DEDR 2408 directly records Tamil caḷi, Kannada caḷi/saḷi, Tulu cali/sali and Telugu calla cold or cool. These simple survey forms are linked to the actual caḷi entry, distinct from taṇ- at 3045; Gondi contact-looking forms are left for donor analysis. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.
